activity.notes: Van Gogh moved to Paris in 1886 and spent the remainder of his artistic career in France, including Arles, Saint-Rémy and Auvers-sur-Oise, until his death in 1890. ATLAS records this major French artistic phase rather than his full transnational life.

sources.title: Vincent van Gogh chronology — Van Gogh Museum
sources.citation_text: The Van Gogh Museum chronology documents Van Gogh's move to France in 1886 and his subsequent work in Paris, Arles, Saint-Rémy and Auvers through 1890.
